description: Synthetic. Type 2 diabetes follow-up with high home readings.

turns.content: I'm 54 and have type 2 diabetes. My morning sugars have been running high lately.
What numbers are you seeing, and what are you taking for it?
Fasting is usually 170 to 190. I take metformin 1000 mg twice a day.
Any increased thirst, urination, or blurry vision?
I'm thirsty and urinating more at night, maybe three times. No blurry vision. No allergies to any medications.
Any recent changes in diet or weight?
I've had more takeout this month and gained about 5 pounds. Nobody else in my family has diabetes except my mother.

description: Synthetic. New-onset symptoms suggestive of hyperglycemia, no known diabetes.

turns.content: I'm 47 and I've been peeing constantly and drinking water all day for about three weeks.
Any weight change or fatigue?
I've lost about 8 pounds without trying and I'm tired all the time.
Any medical conditions, medications, or family history?
No medications, no conditions. My father has diabetes. I don't smoke and I drink a beer on weekends.
Any vomiting, abdominal pain, or breathing changes?
No, nothing like that.

description: Synthetic. Hypertension with self-measured home readings and an ACE inhibitor cough.

turns.content: I'm 61 with high blood pressure. I take lisinopril 20 mg and lately I have a dry cough that won't quit.
How long has the cough been going on, and any fever or sputum?
About six weeks. No fever, no phlegm. It's worse at night.
What have your home blood pressure readings been?
Around 128 over 78 most mornings with my home cuff.
Any chest pain, shortness of breath, or leg swelling? Allergies?
None of that. I'm allergic to penicillin, it gave me a rash.

description: Synthetic. Elevated home readings with headaches, taking medication inconsistently.

turns.content: My home blood pressure readings have been high, like 158 over 96, for the past week.
Are you on any medication for blood pressure?
I'm supposed to take amlodipine 5 mg but I've missed it about half the days.
Any symptoms with it, like headaches, vision changes, chest pain?
Mild headaches in the morning. No vision changes, no chest pain. I've also been eating a lot of salty food and I've been stressed at work.
Any allergies or other medical history?
No allergies. I'm 49 and have high cholesterol too, no medication for it.

description: Synthetic. Elevated cholesterol, family history, asking about starting treatment.

turns.content: My recent lab results showed my LDL is 168 and my doctor suggested a follow-up. I'm 52.
Do you have any family history of heart disease?
My father had a heart attack at 55. My brother also has high cholesterol.
Any symptoms such as chest pain, or shortness of breath with exertion?
No, none. I walk 30 minutes most days without any problem.
Do you take any medications or supplements, and do you smoke?
I take a daily multivitamin and nothing else. I quit smoking eight years ago. No allergies.

description: Synthetic. Statin intolerance with muscle aches.

turns.content: Since I started rosuvastatin two months ago my thighs and calves ache.
How bad is the pain, and does it limit you?
It's about a 4 out of 10. I can still walk and climb stairs. My urine is normal.
Do you have other conditions or medications?
I have type 2 diabetes on metformin and I'm 58. I take nothing else, no known drug allergies.

description: Synthetic. Atypical exertional fatigue and mild breathlessness in a patient with risk factors, stable and non-emergent.

turns.content: I'm 63 with diabetes and high blood pressure. Over the last month I get winded walking up a hill that didn't bother me before.
Does it come with chest pain, pressure, or sweating?
No chest pain at all. I just get short of breath and need to stop for a minute, then I'm okay.
Any swelling in your legs, palpitations, or waking up breathless at night?
No swelling. No palpitations. I sleep on one pillow and sleep fine.
What medicines do you take?
Metformin and lisinopril. No allergies. I smoked for 20 years, quit five years ago.
